text:
</sub>  Attribute findings without relying on literal wording

When the model paraphrases a swept defect without repeating one of its configured substrings, this classifier records the finding as uncategorized and marks the actual category `produced_none`, even though the finding semantically fits that category. The model output contract supplies no category identifier, so case-insensitive substring matching cannot satisfy AC1/AC20 or reliably attribute precision regressions; the tests cover only hand-written matching text. Carry explicit category IDs in the model result, or otherwise define an attribution mechanism that does not depend on the model echoing list wording.
